title: Let's Practice English Speaking With Shadowing! (B2 Level)

segments.text: Welcome to your B2 shadowing session.
segments.ipa: /ˈwɛlkəm tu jɔr bi ˈʃædoʊɪŋ ˈsɛʃən/

segments.text: Today, we're going to practice together, you and me.
segments.ipa: /təˈdeɪ wir ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu ˈpræktəs təˈɡɛðər ju ənd mi/

segments.text: No speaking partner needed, just your voice, your full attention, and the willingness to sound a little silly before you start sounding great.
segments.ipa: /noʊ ˈspikɪŋ ˈpɑrtnər ˈnidəd dʒʌst jɔr vɔɪs jɔr fʊl əˈtɛnʃən ənd ðə ˈwɪlɪŋnəs tu saʊnd ə ˈlɪtəl ˈsɪli bɪˈfɔr ju stɑrt ˈsaʊndɪŋ ɡreɪt/

segments.text: This session is designed for B2 learners.
segments.ipa: /ðɪs ˈsɛʃən ɪz dɪˈzaɪnd fɔr bi ˈlɝnərz/

segments.text: That means the vocabulary, the rhythm, and the sentence complexity are all calibrated to stretch you,
segments.ipa: /ðæt minz ðə voʊˈkæbjəˌlɛri ðə ˈrɪðəm ənd ðə ˈsɛntəns kəmˈplɛksəti ɑr ɔl ˈkæləˌbreɪtəd tu strɛtʃ ju/

segments.text: not overwhelm you.
segments.ipa: /nɑt ˌoʊvərˈwɛlm ju/

segments.text: If something feels slightly beyond your comfort zone, that's exactly where it should be.
segments.ipa: /ɪf ˈsʌmθɪŋ filz ˈslaɪtli bɪˈɑnd jɔr ˈkʌmfərt zoʊn ðæts ɪɡˈzæktli wɛr ɪt ʃʊd bi/

segments.text: Here's how this works.
segments.ipa: /hɪrz haʊ ðɪs wɝks/

segments.text: I'm going to read a series of sentences and short passages.
segments.ipa: /aɪm ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu rɛd ə ˈsɪriz ʌv ˈsɛntənsəz ənd ʃɔrt ˈpæsədʒəz/

segments.text: Everyday conversational English at B2 level.
segments.ipa: /ˈɛvriˈdeɪ ˌkɑnvərˈseɪʃənəl ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ æt bi ˈlɛvəl/

segments.text: You know, the kind of language you would use to express opinions, for example,
segments.ipa: /ju noʊ ðə kaɪnd ʌv ˈlæŋɡwədʒ ju wʊd jus tu ɪkˈsprɛs əˈpɪnjənz fɔr ɪɡˈzæmpəl/

segments.text: or tell a story, or discuss something that matters to you.
segments.ipa: /ɔr tɛl ə ˈstɔri ɔr dɪˈskʌs ˈsʌmθɪŋ ðæt ˈmætərz tu ju/

segments.text: And then, after each one, I'll give you a pause.
segments.ipa: /ənd ðɛn ˈæftər itʃ wʌn aɪl ɡɪv ju ə pɔz/

segments.text: That's your moment.
segments.ipa: /ðæts jɔr ˈmoʊmənt/

segments.text: You repeat what I said, out loud, not in your head.
segments.ipa: /ju rɪˈpit wʌt aɪ sɛd aʊt laʊd nɑt ɪn jɔr hɛd/

segments.text: Try to match my rhythm, my stress, and my intonation as closely as you can.
segments.ipa: /traɪ tu mætʃ maɪ ˈrɪðəm maɪ strɛs ənd maɪ ˌɪntəˈneɪʃən æz ˈkloʊsli æz ju kæn/

segments.text: Don't worry about being perfect.
segments.ipa: /doʊnt ˈwɝi əˈbaʊt ˈbiɪŋ pərˈfɛkt/

segments.text: Worry about being present.
segments.ipa: /ˈwɝi əˈbaʊt ˈbiɪŋ ˈprɛzənt/

segments.text: Stay in the moment, stay with the sound, and keep going even when it doesn't come out exactly right.
segments.ipa: /steɪ ɪn ðə ˈmoʊmənt steɪ wɪð ðə saʊnd ənd kip ˈɡoʊɪŋ ˈivɪn wɛn ɪt ˈdʌzənt kʌm aʊt ɪɡˈzæktli raɪt/

segments.text: If you haven't watched my video on how to do shadowing correctly, by the way,
segments.ipa: /ɪf ju ˈhævənt wɑtʃt maɪ ˈvɪdioʊ ɑn haʊ tu du ˈʃædoʊɪŋ kərˈɛktli baɪ ðə weɪ/

segments.text: I'll leave a link to that video in the description.
segments.ipa: /aɪl liv ə lɪŋk tu ðæt ˈvɪdioʊ ɪn ðə dɪˈskrɪpʃən/

segments.text: That will make this session significantly more effective. All right?
segments.ipa: /ðæt wɪl meɪk ðɪs ˈsɛʃən sɪɡˈnɪfɪkəntli mɔr ɪˈfɛktɪv ɔl raɪt/

segments.text: Session one, expressing opinions.
segments.ipa: /ˈsɛʃən wʌn ɪkˈsprɛsɪŋ əˈpɪnjənz/

segments.text: In this first section, we're going to practice expressing opinions.
segments.ipa: /ɪn ðɪs fɝst ˈsɛkʃən wir ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu ˈpræktəs ɪkˈsprɛsɪŋ əˈpɪnjənz/

segments.text: This is some of the most important conversational English at B2 level.
segments.ipa: /ðɪs ɪz sʌm ʌv ðə moʊst ˌɪmˈpɔrtənt ˌkɑnvərˈseɪʃənəl ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ æt bi ˈlɛvəl/

segments.text: The language you use when someone asks what you think, how you feel, or where you stand on something.
segments.ipa: /ðə ˈlæŋɡwədʒ ju jus wɛn ˈsʌmˌwʌn æsks wʌt ju θɪŋk haʊ ju fil ɔr wɛr ju stænd ɑn ˈsʌmθɪŋ/

segments.text: I'll read each sentence.
segments.ipa: /aɪl rɛd itʃ ˈsɛntəns/

segments.text: You repeat after me.
segments.ipa: /ju rɪˈpit ˈæftər mi/

segments.text: Focus on the rhythm, where the stress falls, where my voice rises, and where it drops.
segments.ipa: /ˈfoʊkəs ɑn ðə ˈrɪðəm wɛr ðə strɛs fɔlz wɛr maɪ vɔɪs ˈraɪzəz ənd wɛr ɪt drɑps/

segments.text: Remember, listen first, then repeat. All right?
segments.ipa: /rɪˈmɛmbər ˈlɪsən fɝst ðɛn rɪˈpit ɔl raɪt/

segments.text: Here we go.
segments.ipa: /hir wi ɡoʊ/

segments.text: Honestly, I think people underestimate how much effort it takes to learn a language well.
segments.ipa: /ˈɑnəstli aɪ θɪŋk ˈpipəl ˈʌndərˈɛstəˌmeɪt haʊ mʌtʃ ˈɛfərt ɪt teɪks tu lɝn ə ˈlæŋɡwədʒ wɛl/

segments.text: I'd say the biggest challenge isn't the grammar.
segments.ipa: /aɪd seɪ ðə ˈbɪɡəst ˈtʃæləndʒ ˈɪzənt ðə ˈɡræmər/

segments.text: It's finding the confidence to actually use it.
segments.ipa: /ɪts ˈfaɪndɪŋ ðə ˈkɑnfədəns tu ˈækˌtʃuəli jus ɪt/

segments.text: Look, I understand why people feel that way, but I'm not sure I agree.
segments.ipa: /lʊk aɪ ˌʌndərˈstænd waɪ ˈpipəl fil ðæt weɪ bʌt aɪm nɑt ʃʊr aɪ əˈɡri/

segments.text: The way I see it, consistency matters a lot more than intensity.
segments.ipa: /ðə weɪ aɪ si ɪt kənˈsɪstənsi ˈmætərz ə lɑt mɔr ðæn ɪnˈtɛnsəti/

segments.text: I mean, it makes sense when you think about it.
segments.ipa: /aɪ min ɪt meɪks sɛns wɛn ju θɪŋk əˈbaʊt ɪt/

segments.text: You can't learn to swim by reading about it.
segments.ipa: /ju kænt lɝn tu swɪm baɪ ˈridɪŋ əˈbaʊt ɪt/

segments.text: To be honest, I've changed my mind about this a few times over the years.
segments.ipa: /tu bi ˈɑnəst aɪv tʃeɪndʒd maɪ maɪnd əˈbaʊt ðɪs ə fju taɪmz ˈoʊvər ðə jɪrz/

segments.text: Well, that really depends on the person, doesn't it?
segments.ipa: /wɛl ðæt ˈrɪli dɪˈpɛndz ɑn ðə ˈpɝsən ˈdʌzənt ɪt/

segments.text: What works for one learner might not work for another.
segments.ipa: /wʌt wɝks fɔr wʌn ˈlɝnər maɪt nɑt wɝk fɔr əˈnʌðər/

segments.text: I'm not saying it's easy.
segments.ipa: /aɪm nɑt ˈseɪɪŋ ɪts ˈizi/

segments.text: I'm saying it's possible.
segments.ipa: /aɪm ˈseɪɪŋ ɪts ˈpɑsəbəl/

segments.text: Those are very different things.
segments.ipa: /ðoʊz ɑr ˈvɛri ˈdɪfərənt θɪŋz/

segments.text: Good work.
segments.ipa: /ɡʊd wɝk/

segments.text: Now, let's do that action one more time, a little faster this time.
segments.ipa: /naʊ lɛts du ðæt ˈækʃən wʌn mɔr taɪm ə ˈlɪtəl ˈfæstər ðɪs taɪm/

segments.text: Really try to match the rhythm.
segments.ipa: /ˈrɪli traɪ tu mætʃ ðə ˈrɪðəm/

segments.text: Here we go.

segments.ipa: /ðoʊz ɑr ˈvɛri ˈdɪfərənt θɪŋz/

segments.text: Well done.
segments.ipa: /wɛl dʌn/

segments.text: Now, let's move on to session two, storytelling.
segments.ipa: /naʊ lɛts muv ɑn tu ˈsɛʃən tu ˈstɔriˌtɛlɪŋ/

segments.text: The ability to narrate a personal experience clearly and naturally in English is one of the clearest markers of B2 level.
segments.ipa: /ðə əˈbɪləˌti tu ˈnɛˌreɪt ə ˈpɝsɪnəl ɪkˈspɪriəns ˈklɪrli ənd ˈnætʃərəli ɪn ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ɪz wʌn ʌv ðə ˈklɪrɪst ˈmɑrkərz ʌv bi ˈlɛvəl/

segments.text: This section will push you a little further on sentence length and complexity. Same rules.
segments.ipa: /ðɪs ˈsɛkʃən wɪl pʊʃ ju ə ˈlɪtəl ˈfɝðər ɑn ˈsɛntəns lɛŋkθ ənd kəmˈplɛksəti seɪm rulz/

segments.text: Hear it first, absorb, repeat it out loud.
segments.ipa: /hir ɪt fɝst əbˈzɔrb rɪˈpit ɪt aʊt laʊd/

segments.text: Don't read ahead.
segments.ipa: /doʊnt rɛd əˈhɛd/

segments.text: Just listen, then follow.
segments.ipa: /dʒʌst ˈlɪsən ðɛn ˈfɑloʊ/

segments.text: I remember the first time I had a real conversation in English.
segments.ipa: /aɪ rɪˈmɛmbər ðə fɝst taɪm aɪ hæd ə ril ˌkɑnvərˈseɪʃən ɪn ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ/

segments.text: I was so nervous I could barely get the words out.
segments.ipa: /aɪ wɑz soʊ ˈnɝvəs aɪ kʊd ˈbɛrli ɡɛt ðə wɝdz aʊt/

segments.text: What surprised me most was how quickly the other person put me at ease.
segments.ipa: /wʌt sərˈpraɪzd mi moʊst wɑz haʊ ˈkwɪkli ðə ˈʌðər ˈpɝsən pʊt mi æt iz/

segments.text: They just kept the conversation going.
segments.ipa: /ðeɪ dʒʌst kɛpt ðə ˌkɑnvərˈseɪʃən ˈɡoʊɪŋ/

segments.text: At some point, I stopped thinking about what I was saying and just started saying it.
segments.ipa: /æt sʌm pɔɪnt aɪ stɑpt ˈθɪŋkɪŋ əˈbaʊt wʌt aɪ wɑz ˈseɪɪŋ ənd dʒʌst ˈstɑrtɪd ˈseɪɪŋ ɪt/

segments.text: And that was the moment things started to click.
segments.ipa: /ənd ðæt wɑz ðə ˈmoʊmənt θɪŋz ˈstɑrtɪd tu klɪk/

segments.text: It wasn't perfect, not by a long shot, but it was real.
segments.ipa: /ɪt ˈwɑzənt pərˈfɛkt nɑt baɪ ə lɔŋ ʃɑt bʌt ɪt wɑz ril/

segments.text: And real felt a lot better than perfect.
segments.ipa: /ənd ril fɛlt ə lɑt ˈbɛtər ðæn pərˈfɛkt/

segments.text: Looking back, I think the biggest thing that held me back wasn't my English.
segments.ipa: /ˈlʊkɪŋ bæk aɪ θɪŋk ðə ˈbɪɡəst θɪŋ ðæt hɛld mi bæk ˈwɑzənt maɪ ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ/

segments.text: It was my fear of getting it wrong.
segments.ipa: /ɪt wɑz maɪ fɪr ʌv ˈɡɛtɪŋ ɪt rɔŋ/

segments.text: Once I let go of that, everything moved faster.
segments.ipa: /wʌns aɪ lɛt ɡoʊ ʌv ðæt ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ muvd ˈfæstər/

segments.text: The mistakes didn't disappear, but they stopped feeling like failures.
segments.ipa: /ðə mɪˈsteɪks ˈdɪdənt ˌdɪsəˈpɪr bʌt ðeɪ stɑpt ˈfilɪŋ laɪk ˈfeɪljərz/

segments.text: I'd been studying for over a year before I finally realized that studying and speaking are two completely different things.
segments.ipa: /aɪd bɪn ˈstʌdiɪŋ fɔr ˈoʊvər ə jɪr bɪˈfɔr aɪ ˈfaɪnəli ˈriəˌlaɪzd ðæt ˈstʌdiɪŋ ənd ˈspikɪŋ ɑr tu kəmˈplitli ˈdɪfərənt θɪŋz/

segments.text: The moment I started treating every conversation as practice, not as a test, the whole experience changed.
segments.ipa: /ðə ˈmoʊmənt aɪ ˈstɑrtɪd ˈtritɪŋ ˈɛvəri ˌkɑnvərˈseɪʃən æz ˈpræktəs nɑt æz ə tɛst ðə hoʊl ɪkˈspɪriəns tʃeɪndʒd/

segments.text: Excellent.
segments.ipa: /ˈɛksələnt/

segments.text: That section was a longer and a bit more complex.
segments.ipa: /ðæt ˈsɛkʃən wɑz ə ˈlɔŋɡər ənd ə bɪt mɔr ˈkɑmplɛks/

segments.text: If some of those felt like a stretch, that's the point.
segments.ipa: /ɪf sʌm ʌv ðoʊz fɛlt laɪk ə strɛtʃ ðæts ðə pɔɪnt/

segments.text: Now, let's run through the last four one more time.

segments.text: Session three, discussing ideas.

segments.text: This is the last section.
segments.ipa: /ðɪs ɪz ðə læst ˈsɛkʃən/

segments.text: This one pushes the register slightly higher toward the kind of English you would use in a professional conversation,
segments.ipa: /ðɪs wʌn ˈpʊʃəz ðə ˈrɛdʒɪstər ˈslaɪtli ˈhaɪər təˈwɔrd ðə kaɪnd ʌv ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ju wʊd jus ɪn ə prəˈfɛʃənəl ˌkɑnvərˈseɪʃən/

segments.text: a presentation, or something that genuinely matters.
segments.ipa: /ə ˌprɛzənˈteɪʃən ɔr ˈsʌmθɪŋ ðæt ˈdʒɛnjəwənli ˈmætərz/

segments.text: This is where B2 meets the edge of C1.
segments.ipa: /ðɪs ɪz wɛr bi mits ðə ɛdʒ ʌv si/

segments.text: Stay with me, you've got this.
segments.ipa: /steɪ wɪð mi juv ɡɑt ðɪs/

segments.text: One of the things that often gets overlooked is that language learning is as much about psychology as it is about linguistics.
segments.ipa: /wʌn ʌv ðə θɪŋz ðæt ˈɔfən ɡɛts ˈoʊvərˌlʊkt ɪz ðæt ˈlæŋɡwədʒ ˈlɝnɪŋ ɪz æz mʌtʃ əˈbaʊt saɪˈkɑlədʒi æz ɪt ɪz əˈbaʊt lɪŋɡˈwɪstɪks/

segments.text: The evidence suggests that consistent daily practice, even in small amounts, outperforms intensive but infrequent study sessions.
segments.ipa: /ðə ˈɛvədəns səˈdʒɛsts ðæt kənˈsɪstənt ˈdeɪli ˈpræktəs ˈivɪn ɪn smɔl əˈmaʊnts ˈaʊtpərˈfɔrmz ˌɪnˈtɛnsɪv bʌt ˌɪnˈfrikwənt ˈstʌdi ˈsɛʃənz/

segments.text: What I find particularly interesting is how the brain adapts over time.
segments.ipa: /wʌt aɪ faɪnd ˌpɑrˈtɪkjələrli ˈɪntrəstɪŋ ɪz haʊ ðə breɪn əˈdæpts ˈoʊvər taɪm/

segments.text: Patterns that once required enormous effort eventually become automatic.
segments.ipa: /ˈpætərnz ðæt wʌns riˈkwaɪərd ɪˈnɔrməs ˈɛfərt ɪˈvɛntʃəwəli bɪˈkʌm ˌɔtəˈmætɪk/

segments.text: I think we sometimes underestimate the role of motivation in language learning.
segments.ipa: /aɪ θɪŋk wi səmˈtaɪmz ˈʌndərˈɛstəˌmeɪt ðə roʊl ʌv ˌmoʊtəˈveɪʃən ɪn ˈlæŋɡwədʒ ˈlɝnɪŋ/

segments.text: It's not just a nice to have, it's fundamental.
segments.ipa: /ɪts nɑt dʒʌst ə naɪs tu hæv ɪts ˌfʌndəˈmɛntəl/

segments.text: The distinction between knowing a language and using it comfortably is something that doesn't get talked about enough.
segments.ipa: /ðə dɪˈstɪŋkʃən bɪˈtwin ˈnoʊɪŋ ə ˈlæŋɡwədʒ ənd ˈjuzɪŋ ɪt ˈkʌmfərtəbli ɪz ˈsʌmθɪŋ ðæt ˈdʌzənt ɡɛt tɔkt əˈbaʊt ɪˈnʌf/

segments.text: Fair enough.
segments.ipa: /fɛr ɪˈnʌf/

segments.text: There's no single method that works for everyone, but there are principles that work,
segments.ipa: /ðɛrz noʊ ˈsɪŋɡəl ˈmɛθəd ðæt wɝks fɔr ˈɛvriˌwʌn bʌt ðɛr ɑr ˈprɪnsəpəlz ðæt wɝk/

segments.text: and those are worth paying attention to.
segments.ipa: /ənd ðoʊz ɑr wɝθ ˈpeɪɪŋ əˈtɛnʃən tu/

segments.text: If I had to summarize it in one sentence, I'd say the gap between understanding English and thinking in English is where fluency lives.
segments.ipa: /ɪf aɪ hæd tu ˈsʌmərˌaɪz ɪt ɪn wʌn ˈsɛntəns aɪd seɪ ðə ɡæp bɪˈtwin ˌʌndərˈstændɪŋ ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ənd ˈθɪŋkɪŋ ɪn ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ɪz wɛr ˈfluənsi lɪvz/

segments.text: And bridging that gap takes time, consistency, and above all, the willingness to be imperfect in pursuit of something better.
segments.ipa: /ənd ˈbrɪdʒɪŋ ðæt ɡæp teɪks taɪm kənˈsɪstənsi ənd əˈbʌv ɔl ðə ˈwɪlɪŋnəs tu bi ˌɪmˈpɝfɪkt ɪn pərˈsut ʌv ˈsʌmθɪŋ ˈbɛtər/

segments.text: That was your B2 shadowing session.
segments.ipa: /ðæt wɑz jɔr bi ˈʃædoʊɪŋ ˈsɛʃən/

segments.text: Well done for showing up and doing the work, three sessions, 24 sentences, B2 to C1 level complexity,
segments.ipa: /wɛl dʌn fɔr ˈʃoʊɪŋ ʌp ənd ˈduɪŋ ðə wɝk θri ˈsɛʃənz ˈsɛntənsəz bi tu si ˈlɛvəl kəmˈplɛksəti/

segments.text: natural rhythm, real conversational English.
segments.ipa: /ˈnætʃərəl ˈrɪðəm ril ˌkɑnvərˈseɪʃənəl ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ/

segments.text: Here's what I want you to do next.
segments.ipa: /hɪrz wʌt aɪ wɑnt ju tu du nɛkst/

segments.text: Come back to this video tomorrow and the day after because the sessions that felt hardest this first time are the ones that produce the biggest improvement by
segments.ipa: /kʌm bæk tu ðɪs ˈvɪdioʊ təˈmɑˌroʊ ənd ðə deɪ ˈæftər bɪˈkɔz ðə ˈsɛʃənz ðæt fɛlt ˈhɑrdəst ðɪs fɝst taɪm ɑr ðə wʌnz ðæt prəˈdus ðə ˈbɪɡəst ˌɪmˈpruvmənt baɪ/

segments.text: the third, fourth, or fifth time through.
segments.ipa: /ðə θɝd fɔrθ ɔr fɪfθ taɪm θru/

segments.text: Your ear and our mouth need repetition, not just exposure.
segments.ipa: /jɔr ir ənd ˈaʊər maʊθ nid ˌrɛpəˈtɪʃən nɑt dʒʌst ɪkˈspoʊʒər/

segments.text: So, if today felt a little bit uncomfortable, you know some of these sentences,
segments.ipa: /soʊ ɪf təˈdeɪ fɛlt ə ˈlɪtəl bɪt ənˈkʌmfərtəbəl ju noʊ sʌm ʌv ðiz ˈsɛntənsəz/

segments.text: if they came out wrong, no problem at all.
segments.ipa: /ɪf ðeɪ keɪm aʊt rɔŋ noʊ ˈprɑbləm æt ɔl/

segments.text: That discomfort is the work doing its job.
segments.ipa: /ðæt dɪˈskʌmfərt ɪz ðə wɝk ˈduɪŋ ɪts dʒɑb/

segments.text: It means you were stretched and stretched is exactly what you want to be.
segments.ipa: /ɪt minz ju wɝ strɛtʃt ənd strɛtʃt ɪz ɪɡˈzæktli wʌt ju wɑnt tu bi/

segments.text: If you want more practice sessions like this one plus structured B2 content and an AI speaking coach for daily conversation practice,
segments.ipa: /ɪf ju wɑnt mɔr ˈpræktəs ˈsɛʃənz laɪk ðɪs wʌn plʌs ˈstrʌktʃərd bi ˈkɑntɛnt ənd æn aɪ ˈspikɪŋ koʊtʃ fɔr ˈdeɪli ˌkɑnvərˈseɪʃən ˈpræktəs/

segments.text: the B2 Edge app is in the description.
segments.ipa: /ðə bi ɛdʒ æp ɪz ɪn ðə dɪˈskrɪpʃən/

segments.text: And there are more shadowing sessions coming on this channel, a B1 level, a C1 level,
segments.ipa: /ənd ðɛr ɑr mɔr ˈʃædoʊɪŋ ˈsɛʃənz ˈkʌmɪŋ ɑn ðɪs ˈtʃænəl ə bi ˈlɛvəl ə si ˈlɛvəl/

segments.text: and with other topics that I'm not going to tell you now.
segments.ipa: /ənd wɪð ˈʌðər ˈtɑpɪks ðæt aɪm nɑt ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu tɛl ju naʊ/

segments.text: So, subscribe to the channel so you don't miss those sessions. I'm Thiago.
segments.ipa: /soʊ səbˈskraɪb tu ðə ˈtʃænəl soʊ ju doʊnt mɪs ðoʊz ˈsɛʃənz aɪm Thiago/

segments.text: Great work today.
segments.ipa: /ɡreɪt wɝk təˈdeɪ/

segments.text: Thanks for hanging out with me.
segments.ipa: /θæŋks fɔr ˈhæŋɪŋ aʊt wɪð mi/

segments.text: And if you want to keep learning more, I highly recommend you check out this lesson next.
segments.ipa: /ənd ɪf ju wɑnt tu kip ˈlɝnɪŋ mɔr aɪ ˈhaɪli ˌrɛkəˈmɛnd ju tʃɛk aʊt ðɪs ˈlɛsən nɛkst/
